crossRefs.note: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness…
“You daughter who dwells in Dibon, come down from your glory, and sit in thirst; for the destroyer of Moab has come up…
on Dibon, on Nebo, on Beth Diblathaim,
I will stretch out my hand on them, and make the land desolate and waste, from the wilderness toward Diblah, throughout…

people.name: Diblathaim
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.

people.name: Dibon
people.line: Moabite city, allotted to Gad, later possessed by Moab.

translations.web: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.
translations.bsb: They set out from Dibon-gad and camped at Almon-diblathaim.
translations.kjv: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
translations.asv: And they journeyed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
